name: net.ws
doc:
WebSockets (RFC 6455) over net.http: the server side upgrades a
request inside an http.Handler (`await ws.Upgrade(req, res)?`), the
client dials ws:// or wss:// URLs (`await ws.Dial(url)?`). Text and
binary messages, fragmentation (received messages are reassembled;
SendFragments sends one), ping/pong (pings are answered automatically),
the closing handshake with status codes, client masking (C helper
net.http.rtMask). permessage-deflate (RFC 7692) is not implemented:
no extension is negotiated. Sends are serialized by a mutex, so several
tasks may send on one Conn; one task at a time should receive.

items.name: Upgrade
items.doc:
Upgrade answers a WebSocket handshake request inside an HTTP handler
(HTTP/1.1 only) and returns the connection; a request that is not a
valid handshake gets 400 (426 for a wrong version) and ErrBadHandshake.
items.summary: Upgrade answers a WebSocket handshake request inside an HTTP handler (HTTP/1.1 only) and returns the connection; a request that is not a valid handshake gets 400 (426 for a wrong version) and ErrBadHandshake.

items.name: UpgradeWith
items.signature: async func UpgradeWith(req *net.http.Request, res *net.http.Response, opts UpgradeOptions) Conn!
items.doc: UpgradeWith is Upgrade with options (subprotocols, origin check, limits).
items.summary: UpgradeWith is Upgrade with options (subprotocols, origin check, limits).

items.name: CloseError
items.doc:
CloseError is the error of Recv once the connection is closed: the
peer's close code (CloseNoStatus if it sent none, CloseAbnormal if the
TCP connection ended without a close frame) and reason.
items.summary: CloseError is the error of Recv once the connection is closed: the peer's close code (CloseNoStatus if it sent none, CloseAbnormal if the TCP connection ended without a close frame) and reason.
